producer_report.summary: Stages S1-S3 of `produce_and_verify` are now in the new `run/producer.rs` as three `pub(super)` methods on `Athena`: `run_baseline`, `prepare_producer` and `run_producer`. `produce_and_verify` calls them in that order. The four early `return Ok(closing)` paths in the producer loop became `return Ok(Flow::Stop)`. The driver reads the result with a `let Flow::Go(Reported {..}) = .. else { return Ok(closing); }`. The S4 idle-producer `return Ok(closing)` and `take_baseline` stay in mod.rs. I added no test and changed no test line. `Closing` goes in as `&mut Closing`. `seq` goes in by value and comes back in `Reported`. The `ProducerSnapshot` struct carries the S2 results into S3. CHANGELOG has an R5 entry, and structure-pass.md has an R5-done paragraph. Clippy objected to one moved statement: `&mut closing` passed to `keep_timed_out_work` became `closing`, and the parameter lost its `mut`. The CHANGELOG lists both. Full `cargo test --locked`, `cargo fmt --all --check` and `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` passed.

checks_run.command: cargo test --locked -p athena-core -- --list --format terse (before and after, saved inside the working directory, then deleted)
checks_run.note: 627 tests both times; both files were 51329 bytes. git diff --no-index is not allowed, so I compared the count and size instead of a line diff.
The first run failed with needless_borrow on `&mut closing`; fixed by passing `closing`.
No failure was reported. The output was too large to read, so I rely on the absence of an error exit.
12 passed. It reads tracked files only, so I reread untracked producer.rs against the banned words by eye.

open_issues: Criterion 6 asks for equal Grep file counts before and after. Where a call moved into producer.rs the file count rises by one. I reported occurrence counts, which are equal, and file counts with the reason in the CHANGELOG, as the plan said.
`cargo test --locked` output was too large to read here. I saw no failure, but Athena's recorded run is the evidence.
The before counts in the CHANGELOG are derived: after counts minus the effect of the move, since nothing else changed. I did not re-measure on the base commit.
mistakes: My first full-block edit left `Flow` and `Reported` unimported in mod.rs, so the build failed once. I added `use producer::{Flow, Reported};`.
I measured the tests with the `--format terse` flag, so I could not compare names line by line. I compared count and file size.
learnings: Bash cannot pipe or tail, and cannot read tool-result files outside the working directory. Large outputs have to be redirected to a file inside the working directory and read with Grep or Read.
Clippy's needless_borrow fires on `&mut closing` when `closing` is already `&mut Closing`. The `mut` on the parameter then goes too.
`Flow` is not used as a Rust name elsewhere in crates/. The only other word matches are in data and gate files, as prose or other identifiers, and in a single mention in close.rs.
`use super::*` in a child module picks up the private `use` items of run/mod.rs, so producer.rs needed only three extra imports (ToolGrant, Composed, BTreeMap).
